subject.title: Model configuration accepts unvalidated model names, enabling silent misconfiguration

question: Should unknown configured model refs be warning-only in doctor/config validate, hard validation errors, or left to runtime/status handling when catalog authority is incomplete?
rationale: Automation can identify the missing validation path, but only maintainers can choose the permanent compatibility policy for custom provider catalogs and future model refs.

options.title: Warning-first validation
options.body: Surface advisory warnings in `config validate` and doctor while preserving runtime compatibility for custom and forward-compatible refs.

options.title: Strict validation
options.body: Reject unknown configured refs before runtime, accepting that some custom or future refs need an explicit escape hatch or migration path.

options.title: Runtime/status only
options.body: Keep validation permissive and rely on improved runtime errors, fallback visibility, and status output instead of preflight catalog checks.

recommendation.title: Warning-first validation
recommendation.body: Surface advisory warnings in `config validate` and doctor while preserving runtime compatibility for custom and forward-compatible refs.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans shared model schema, runtime catalog authority, and compatibility policy, and steipete is the strongest cross-surface history signal in those paths.
